Antwerp's trade reads Switzerland's watch numbers: exports rose 9.1%, but the United States, largest market, fell 19.4%.

FH: August was CHF 1,789.2m, one extra working day. UK up 46.1%, France 113.5%. Eight months: +1.7%, above CHF 17bn — first positive 12-month average in two years.
